package vultr.vultr_dns.vultr_dns_dns_dnssec_enabled_t15

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce DNSSEC Signature Validation on Vultr Hosted Zones (Tier-15 • Profile Q)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_dns_domain"
  not r.change.after.dnssec
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure dnssec for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Vultr: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Vultr DNS"]
      requirement["Enforce DNSSEC Signature Validation on Vultr Hosted Zones"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:vultr-iam", label: "Vultr API key or subaccount permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: VULTR-BP-0387"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Vultr: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:vultr-dns", label: "Vultr DNS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:vultr-logging", label: "Vultr system audit logs and resource readback", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_daily_snapshot_rule_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Daily Automated Snapshots for Persistent Block Storage
# Compliance: CIS Vultr Cloud Benchmark v1.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.schedule
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure schedule for compliance standard CIS Vultr Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_snapshot_retention_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Retain at Least 30 Days of Point-in-Time Disaster Recovery Snapshots
# Compliance: CIS Vultr Security Guidelines, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP Moderate
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.retention_days
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure retention_days for compliance standard CIS Vultr Security Guidelines", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_cross_region_replication_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Replicate Snapshot Archives Across Secondary Geographic Locations
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.replica_region
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure replica_region for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_daily_snapshot_rule_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Daily Automated Snapshots for Persistent Block Storage (Tier-2 • Profile D)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.schedule
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure schedule for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      change["Proposed configuration for Vultr Backup & Snapshots"]

      identity@{ icon: "logos:vultr-iam", label: "Vultr API key or subaccount permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: VULTR-BP-0391"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Vultr: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:vultr-backup", label: "Vultr Backup & Snapshots", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:vultr-logging", label: "Vultr system audit logs and resource readback", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_snapshot_retention_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Retain at Least 30 Days of Point-in-Time Disaster Recovery Snapshots (Tier-2 • Profile E)
# Compliance: CIS Vultr Cloud Benchmark v1.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.retention_days
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure retention_days for compliance standard CIS Vultr Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_cross_region_replication_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Replicate Snapshot Archives Across Secondary Geographic Locations (Tier-2 • Profile F)
# Compliance: CIS Vultr Security Guidelines, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP Moderate
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.replica_region
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure replica_region for compliance standard CIS Vultr Security Guidelines", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

title: Enforce Daily Automated Snapshots for Persistent Block Storage (Tier-3 • Profile G)
description: Backup and restore integration for Vultr Backup & Snapshots. Integration contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO. Control: Enforce Daily Automated Snapshots for Persistent Block Storage.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_daily_snapshot_rule_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Daily Automated Snapshots for Persistent Block Storage (Tier-3 • Profile G)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.schedule
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure schedule for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Vultr: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Vultr Backup & Snapshots"]
      requirement["Enforce Daily Automated Snapshots for Persistent Block Storage"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:vultr-iam", label: "Vultr API key or subaccount permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: VULTR-BP-0394"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Vultr: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:vultr-backup", label: "Vultr Backup & Snapshots", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:vultr-logging", label: "Vultr system audit logs and resource readback", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_snapshot_retention_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Retain at Least 30 Days of Point-in-Time Disaster Recovery Snapshots (Tier-3 • Profile H)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.retention_days
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure retention_days for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_cross_region_replication_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Replicate Snapshot Archives Across Secondary Geographic Locations (Tier-3 • Profile I)
# Compliance: CIS Vultr Cloud Benchmark v1.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.replica_region
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure replica_region for compliance standard CIS Vultr Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_daily_snapshot_rule_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Daily Automated Snapshots for Persistent Block Storage (Tier-4 • Profile J)
# Compliance: CIS Vultr Security Guidelines, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP Moderate
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.schedule
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure schedule for compliance standard CIS Vultr Security Guidelines", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.

vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_snapshot_retention_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Retain at Least 30 Days of Point-in-Time Disaster Recovery Snapshots (Tier-4 • Profile K)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.retention_days
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure retention_days for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Vultr: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Vultr Backup & Snapshots"]
      requirement["Retain at Least 30 Days of Point-in-Time Disaster Recovery Snapshots"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:vultr-iam", label: "Vultr API key or subaccount permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: VULTR-BP-0398"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Vultr: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:vultr-backup", label: "Vultr Backup & Snapshots", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:vultr-logging", label: "Vultr system audit logs and resource readback", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.

vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_cross_region_replication_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Replicate Snapshot Archives Across Secondary Geographic Locations (Tier-4 • Profile L)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.replica_region
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure replica_region for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_daily_snapshot_rule_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Daily Automated Snapshots for Persistent Block Storage (Tier-5 • Profile M)
# Compliance: CIS Vultr Cloud Benchmark v1.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.schedule
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure schedule for compliance standard CIS Vultr Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_snapshot_retention_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Retain at Least 30 Days of Point-in-Time Disaster Recovery Snapshots (Tier-5 • Profile N)
# Compliance: CIS Vultr Security Guidelines, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP Moderate
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.retention_days
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure retention_days for compliance standard CIS Vultr Security Guidelines", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_cross_region_replication_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Replicate Snapshot Archives Across Secondary Geographic Locations (Tier-5 • Profile O)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.replica_region
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure replica_region for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end

      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]

      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Vultr: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:vultr-backup", label: "Vultr Backup & Snapshots", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:vultr-logging", label: "Vultr system audit logs and resource readback", h: 64, pos: "b" }

      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_daily_snapshot_rule_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Daily Automated Snapshots for Persistent Block Storage (Tier-6 • Profile P)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.schedule
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure schedule for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_snapshot_retention_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Retain at Least 30 Days of Point-in-Time Disaster Recovery Snapshots (Tier-6 • Profile Q)
# Compliance: CIS Vultr Cloud Benchmark v1.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.retention_days
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure retention_days for compliance standard CIS Vultr Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_cross_region_replication_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Replicate Snapshot Archives Across Secondary Geographic Locations (Tier-6 • Profile R)
# Compliance: CIS Vultr Security Guidelines, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP Moderate
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.replica_region
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure replica_region for compliance standard CIS Vultr Security Guidelines", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_daily_snapshot_rule_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Daily Automated Snapshots for Persistent Block Storage (Tier-7 • Profile S)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.schedule
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure schedule for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.

checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_snapshot_retention_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Retain at Least 30 Days of Point-in-Time Disaster Recovery Snapshots (Tier-7 • Profile T)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.retention_days
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure retention_days for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

    end

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_cross_region_replication_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Replicate Snapshot Archives Across Secondary Geographic Locations (Tier-7 • Profile U)
# Compliance: CIS Vultr Cloud Benchmark v1.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.replica_region
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure replica_region for compliance standard CIS Vultr Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

title: Enforce Daily Automated Snapshots for Persistent Block Storage (Tier-8 • Profile V)
description: Backup and restore integration for Vultr Backup & Snapshots. Integration contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO. Control: Enforce Daily Automated Snapshots for Persistent Block Storage.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_daily_snapshot_rule_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Daily Automated Snapshots for Persistent Block Storage (Tier-8 • Profile V)
# Compliance: CIS Vultr Security Guidelines, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP Moderate
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.schedule
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure schedule for compliance standard CIS Vultr Security Guidelines", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Vultr: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Vultr Backup & Snapshots"]
      requirement["Enforce Daily Automated Snapshots for Persistent Block Storage"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:vultr-iam", label: "Vultr API key or subaccount permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: VULTR-BP-0409"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Vultr: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:vultr-backup", label: "Vultr Backup & Snapshots", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:vultr-logging", label: "Vultr system audit logs and resource readback", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_snapshot_retention_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Retain at Least 30 Days of Point-in-Time Disaster Recovery Snapshots (Tier-8 • Profile W)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.retention_days
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure retention_days for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_cross_region_replication_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Replicate Snapshot Archives Across Secondary Geographic Locations (Tier-8 • Profile X)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.replica_region
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure replica_region for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_daily_snapshot_rule_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Daily Automated Snapshots for Persistent Block Storage (Tier-9 • Profile Y)
# Compliance: CIS Vultr Cloud Benchmark v1.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.schedule
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure schedule for compliance standard CIS Vultr Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_snapshot_retention_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Retain at Least 30 Days of Point-in-Time Disaster Recovery Snapshots (Tier-9 • Profile Z)
# Compliance: CIS Vultr Security Guidelines, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP Moderate
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.retention_days
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure retention_days for compliance standard CIS Vultr Security Guidelines", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Vultr: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Vultr Backup & Snapshots"]
      requirement["Retain at Least 30 Days of Point-in-Time Disaster Recovery Snapshots"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:vultr-iam", label: "Vultr API key or subaccount permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: VULTR-BP-0413"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Vultr: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:vultr-backup", label: "Vultr Backup & Snapshots", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:vultr-logging", label: "Vultr system audit logs and resource readback", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.

developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_cross_region_replication_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Replicate Snapshot Archives Across Secondary Geographic Locations (Tier-9 • Profile A)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.replica_region
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure replica_region for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_daily_snapshot_rule_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Daily Automated Snapshots for Persistent Block Storage (Tier-10 • Profile B)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.schedule
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure schedule for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

default allow = false

# Rule: Retain at Least 30 Days of Point-in-Time Disaster Recovery Snapshots (Tier-10 • Profile C)
# Compliance: CIS Vultr Cloud Benchmark v1.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.retention_days
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure retention_days for compliance standard CIS Vultr Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_cross_region_replication_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Replicate Snapshot Archives Across Secondary Geographic Locations (Tier-10 • Profile D)
# Compliance: CIS Vultr Security Guidelines, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP Moderate
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.replica_region
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure replica_region for compliance standard CIS Vultr Security Guidelines", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Vultr: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Vultr Backup & Snapshots"]
      requirement["Replicate Snapshot Archives Across Secondary Geographic Locations"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:vultr-iam", label: "Vultr API key or subaccount permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: VULTR-BP-0417"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Vultr: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:vultr-backup", label: "Vultr Backup & Snapshots", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:vultr-logging", label: "Vultr system audit logs and resource readback", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_daily_snapshot_rule_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Daily Automated Snapshots for Persistent Block Storage (Tier-11 • Profile E)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.schedule
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure schedule for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_backup.vultr_backup_backup_snapshot_retention_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Retain at Least 30 Days of Point-in-Time Disaster Recovery Snapshots (Tier-11 • Profile F)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_snapshot"
  not r.change.after.retention_days
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure retention_days for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
