developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.

checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_dr.vultr_dr_dr_rpo_fifteen_minutes_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce 15-Minute Recovery Point Objective (RPO) on Critical Databases (Tier-10 • Profile C)
# Compliance: CIS Vultr Cloud Benchmark v1.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_database"
  not r.change.after.rpo_minutes
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure rpo_minutes for compliance standard CIS Vultr Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package vultr.vultr_dr.vultr_dr_dr_drill_simulation_schedule_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Conduct Automated Monthly DR Drill Simulations with Readback Validation (Tier-10 • Profile D)
# Compliance: CIS Vultr Security Guidelines, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP Moderate
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_dr_plan"
  not r.change.after.drill_frequency
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure drill_frequency for compliance standard CIS Vultr Security Guidelines", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package vultr.vultr_dr.vultr_dr_dr_cross_datacenter_plan_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Configure Automated Cross-Continent Disaster Recovery Failover Plans (Tier-11 • Profile E)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_dr_plan"
  not r.change.after.target_region
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure target_region for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_dr.vultr_dr_dr_rpo_fifteen_minutes_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce 15-Minute Recovery Point Objective (RPO) on Critical Databases (Tier-11 • Profile F)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_database"
  not r.change.after.rpo_minutes
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure rpo_minutes for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package vultr.vultr_dr.vultr_dr_dr_drill_simulation_schedule_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Conduct Automated Monthly DR Drill Simulations with Readback Validation (Tier-11 • Profile G)
# Compliance: CIS Vultr Cloud Benchmark v1.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_dr_plan"
  not r.change.after.drill_frequency
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure drill_frequency for compliance standard CIS Vultr Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_dr.vultr_dr_dr_cross_datacenter_plan_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Configure Automated Cross-Continent Disaster Recovery Failover Plans (Tier-12 • Profile H)
# Compliance: CIS Vultr Security Guidelines, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP Moderate
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_dr_plan"
  not r.change.after.target_region
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure target_region for compliance standard CIS Vultr Security Guidelines", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Vultr: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Vultr Disaster Recovery"]

      identity@{ icon: "logos:vultr-iam", label: "Vultr API key or subaccount permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: VULTR-BP-1023"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_dr.vultr_dr_dr_rpo_fifteen_minutes_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce 15-Minute Recovery Point Objective (RPO) on Critical Databases (Tier-12 • Profile I)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_database"
  not r.change.after.rpo_minutes
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure rpo_minutes for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Vultr: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Vultr Disaster Recovery"]
      requirement["Enforce 15-Minute Recovery Point Objective (RPO) on Critical Databases"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:vultr-iam", label: "Vultr API key or subaccount permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: VULTR-BP-1024"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Vultr: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:vultr-dr", label: "Vultr Disaster Recovery", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:vultr-logging", label: "Vultr system audit logs and resource readback", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.

vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_dr.vultr_dr_dr_drill_simulation_schedule_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Conduct Automated Monthly DR Drill Simulations with Readback Validation (Tier-12 • Profile J)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_dr_plan"
  not r.change.after.drill_frequency
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure drill_frequency for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package vultr.vultr_dr.vultr_dr_dr_cross_datacenter_plan_t13

default allow = false

# Rule: Configure Automated Cross-Continent Disaster Recovery Failover Plans (Tier-13 • Profile K)
# Compliance: CIS Vultr Cloud Benchmark v1.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_dr_plan"
  not r.change.after.target_region
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure target_region for compliance standard CIS Vultr Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

title: Enforce 15-Minute Recovery Point Objective (RPO) on Critical Databases (Tier-13 • Profile L)
description: Backup and restore integration for Vultr Disaster Recovery. Integration contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO. Control: Enforce 15-Minute Recovery Point Objective (RPO) on Critical Databases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_dr.vultr_dr_dr_rpo_fifteen_minutes_t13

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce 15-Minute Recovery Point Objective (RPO) on Critical Databases (Tier-13 • Profile L)
# Compliance: CIS Vultr Security Guidelines, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP Moderate
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_database"
  not r.change.after.rpo_minutes
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure rpo_minutes for compliance standard CIS Vultr Security Guidelines", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

    end

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_dr.vultr_dr_dr_drill_simulation_schedule_t13

default allow = false

# Rule: Conduct Automated Monthly DR Drill Simulations with Readback Validation (Tier-13 • Profile M)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_dr_plan"
  not r.change.after.drill_frequency
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure drill_frequency for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.

vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_dr.vultr_dr_dr_cross_datacenter_plan_t14

default allow = false

# Rule: Configure Automated Cross-Continent Disaster Recovery Failover Plans (Tier-14 • Profile N)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_dr_plan"
  not r.change.after.target_region
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure target_region for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_dr.vultr_dr_dr_rpo_fifteen_minutes_t14

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce 15-Minute Recovery Point Objective (RPO) on Critical Databases (Tier-14 • Profile O)
# Compliance: CIS Vultr Cloud Benchmark v1.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_database"
  not r.change.after.rpo_minutes
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure rpo_minutes for compliance standard CIS Vultr Cloud Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package vultr.vultr_dr.vultr_dr_dr_drill_simulation_schedule_t14

default allow = false

# Rule: Conduct Automated Monthly DR Drill Simulations with Readback Validation (Tier-14 • Profile P)
# Compliance: CIS Vultr Security Guidelines, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP Moderate
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_dr_plan"
  not r.change.after.drill_frequency
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure drill_frequency for compliance standard CIS Vultr Security Guidelines", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Vultr CLI (vultr-cli) or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Vultr: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Vultr Disaster Recovery"]
      requirement["Conduct Automated Monthly DR Drill Simulations with Readback Validation"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:vultr-iam", label: "Vultr API key or subaccount permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: VULTR-BP-1031"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Vultr: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:vultr-dr", label: "Vultr Disaster Recovery", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:vultr-logging", label: "Vultr system audit logs and resource readback", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package vultr.vultr_dr.vultr_dr_dr_cross_datacenter_plan_t15

default allow = false

# Rule: Configure Automated Cross-Continent Disaster Recovery Failover Plans (Tier-15 • Profile Q)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "vultr_dr_plan"
  not r.change.after.target_region
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure target_region for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
vultr-cli account info
: "${SUB_ID:?Set SUB_ID to an active Vultr subscription ID}"
vultr-cli instance list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.
